learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn the rules of narration, transforming Direct Speech into Indirect Speech by mastering changes in tenses, pronouns, and expressions of time and place.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 You can repeat exactly what someone said like a parrot (Direct Speech), or you can report what they said like an undercover agent (Indirect Speech)! Let's learn the top-secret rules of Narration! 🕵️‍♂️

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Direct speech uses quotation marks to show exact words. To change to Indirect, we remove quotes, add the connector 'that', and change the pronouns to fit the reporter's point of view. If the reporting verb has an object, 'said to' changes to 'told'.
examples_or_templates: Direct: Rahul said to me, "I am your friend."
Indirect: Rahul TOLD me THAT HE was MY friend.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: If the reporting verb is in the PAST tense (e.g., 'said'), all present tenses inside the quotes shift back one step into the PAST. Present becomes Past. Past becomes Past Perfect.
examples_or_templates: Simple Present ➡️ Simple Past: "I like ice cream," she said. ➡️ She said that she LIKED ice cream.
Simple Past ➡️ Past Perfect: "I finished the work," he said. ➡️ He said that he HAD FINISHED the work.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words showing 'nearness' in time or place change to words showing 'distance' in Indirect Speech because the reporting happens at a different time and place.
examples_or_templates: Today ➡️ That day, Tomorrow ➡️ The next day
Indirect: He said that he would go there THE NEXT DAY.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Convert to Indirect Speech: Rita said, "I am reading a book."
options: Rita said that I am reading a book.
Rita said that she is reading a book.
Rita said that she was reading a book.
Rita said that she had been reading a book.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: Rita said that she was reading a book.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What does the word 'yesterday' change to in Indirect Speech?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change the pronouns and connector: John said, "I left my bag here."
subjective_practice.hint: Remove quotes, add 'that', change 'I' to 'he', 'my' to 'his', and don't forget to change 'here'!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Backshift the tense: The teacher said, "The Earth goes around the sun."
subjective_practice.hint: TRICK QUESTION! Universal truths and facts DO NOT change their tense in indirect speech.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite into Direct Speech: She said that she would be late that day.
subjective_practice.hint: Put quotes back. Change 'she' to 'I', 'would' to 'will', and 'that day' back to its present form.

activity_or_assignment.title: 👂 The Eavesdropper
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Listen to a short conversation between two family members or friends. Write down 3 exact quotes (Direct Speech). Then, write a 'Spy Report' changing those quotes into Indirect Speech to show what you overheard!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Remove quotation marks and use 'that' to connect the clauses.
⭐ Backshift tenses if the reporting verb is in the past (e.g., 'said'): Present becomes Past, Past becomes Past Perfect.
⭐ Change time/place words to show distance (today ➡️ that day, here ➡️ there).
